title: Highly sensitive spider-slit-organ-inspired crack-based flexible temperature sensor
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19369-19374
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02392K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ping Li, Yi Yang, Jing Chen, Libo Zhao, Tianling Ren
We found that a spider-slit-inspired graphene sensor can not only be used for detecting tiny vibrations, but it is also highly sensitive to temperature changes: the highest temperature sensitivity was 9.93 × 10−3 °C−1.
